subtasks.name: pick(left_book)
subtasks.outcome: failed: grasped the robot-right (image-left) book instead

subtasks.name: place(left_book, shelf, on)
subtasks.outcome: never attempted; the target robot-left book was pressed down and tipped flat

behaviour_summary: pi0 grasps the robot-right book (40-100), carries it right, presses it down onto the robot-left book (260-340) so that book ends lying flat, and leaves.
runs_trained_task: No libero_10 task exists in STUDY_SCENE4. The motion (grasp the image-left book, carry it to the robot's left / image right-back and set it down) resembles the STUDY_SCENE1 libero_10 task 'pick up the book and place it in the back compartment of the caddy', where the book starts on the image left and the caddy sits back-right; cross-scene transfer, low-medium confidence.

failures.mode_definition: Grasps a different instance of the object category than the one singled out by the instruction's referring expression (position/ordinal/colour qualifier), typically a habitual or default instance.
hl_remedy: HALT when the gripper descends toward a book that VERIFY (zoomed image) says is not the referred book
if a wrong book is already in hand: open the gripper in place to set it down, then RETREAT up 10 cm
REPROMPT 'pick up the book on the left and place it on top of the shelf'
VERIFY the referred book is between the fingers after closure
WATCH 5 s for transport toward the cabinet shelf; retry once, then ESCALATE
failures.prevention: Coordinator grounds the referring expression (left/middle/right are robot-frame, i.e. mirrored in the agent view) to an image location and VERIFYs the approach target before gripper closure; add a distinguishing attribute (e.g. colour) to the prompt when one exists.
failures.observation: 40: gripper over the image-left book; 60-80 descends and closes on it; 120-160 lifted and carried right.

failures.mode_definition: Transports the grasped object to a location other than the instructed destination fixture/region and releases or abandons it there.
hl_remedy: HALT when the EE carrying the object moves away from the instructed destination for 2 frames
RETREAT up 10 cm keeping the grasp (if already released, VERIFY where the object lies)
REPROMPT 'pick up the book on the left and place it on top of the shelf'
WATCH 5 s for motion toward the destination; retry once, then ESCALATE
failures.prevention: Coordinator declares the destination region in image space and the FR agent HALTs on the first frames of transport heading elsewhere; pi0 has a strong scene-independent 'carry to robot-left/back' habit for books.
failures.observation: 140-240 held book carried to the robot's left; 260 pressed down onto the robot-left book, which tilts (280-300) and lies flat by 340-360. The shelf on the image left is never approached.

notes: At 409 only one flat grey book is visible beside the black book; the picked book may be lying on top of the knocked-over target or out of frame. Collateral knock-over of the target book (260-340).
